original_caption: Overview of heterogeneous split execution on u.RECS. (a) Unpopulated carrier and module locations. (b) Host-mediated execution with transfer, conversion, buffering, and synchronization; completion includes output materialization and required postprocessing. (c) The Generic runner supports single- and multi-tensor boundaries; the current Native interface requires one suffix input. Illustrative cuts differ. Paired measurements use identical compatible cuts and compiled subgraphs.
